Getting ₹20,000+ worth of Accor points by paying a joining fee of ₹5,900 was an excellent deal. Even better, during the next two renewals, I received 10,000 Accor points each time against renewal fee payments: ✅ Once for crossing ₹7.5 lakh annual spends. ✅ Once after crossing ₹15 lakh spends in Jan’26. These renewal Accor points against the fee payments would not have been available on the Lifetime Free variant. 2️⃣ HDFC Infinia (when it had 1:1 Accor transfers) When Infinia offered 1:1 Accor point transfers, I didn’t try to meet the ₹10 lakh fee waiver criteria, even though I could have easily done so by preponing a few expenses.
